title: Delhi NCR Regional AQI - Night (02:30) vs Evening Peak (17:59)
source: Open-Meteo Air Quality API (CAMS) - US EPA AQI | stations: CPCB/CAAQMS reference locations

methodology.aqiStandard: US EPA AQI (as published by the Open-Meteo Air Quality API)
methodology.interpolation: 02:30 and 17:59 are linearly interpolated between the neighbouring hourly model steps (02:00/03:00 and 17:00/18:00 IST).
methodology.baseline: Mean of the 30 preceding days at the same clock times.

emissionModel.formula: kg/day = concentration(ug/m3) x 1e-6 x mixingHeight(m) x zoneArea(m2) x 1 turnover/day / 1000

carbonModel.formula: tCO2e/yr = avoidablePM2.5(kg/day) x reductionPotential x 2.7 kgCO2e/kgPM x 365 / 1000
